task.goal: Repair runtime cost and model evidence parsing without changing successful-result behavior or public contracts.
task.observed: Local repro: total_cost_usd=-2 survives as costUsd=-2; modelUsage with two entries plus model=expected returns expected. No production incident established.
acceptance: Finite nonnegative numeric costs, including zero, survive; negative, missing and nonnumeric costs stay unknown (null).

Existing runtime tests pass, test sources and unrelated files unchanged; report limitations and evidence.
rules: Only change src/runtime.js. No commit/push/install/deploy/global settings/port3000/secrets.
Use native coding context and tools within the same scope; no paid subagents or extra models.
Run supplied tests and inspect the diff; give one concise result/evidence/limitations report. No mandatory questions per tool.
No hidden answer, solution patch or output from the other arm is available. Do not read the other arm.

Native direct context management and ordinary read/edit/test self-correction remain enabled within the one invocation. Do not stop after an unverified first patch when time remains. Internal edit/test cycles are not additional writer invocations.

Respect the actual tool permissions of your arm. Direct native Bash is allowed for scoped read/test work. The managed writer currently lacks Bash; its independent checker is outside the writer. Tool rights are intentionally asymmetric and must be disclosed, never counted as an equal-tool model comparison.
